args.body: Advance CATALOGUE-ONE-COMMAND-QA-TRIAL under a valid lease. Reuse an equivalent committed runner if one exists. Otherwise build the smallest offline runner with original fictional inputs and documented file provenance. Exercise its normal command from a clean directory on the clean control and duplicate-image case. Require exit 0 on the clean case and a nonzero exit with an actionable style-level finding on the duplicate case. Record actual output and count every prerequisite file, setup step and command against L71. A wrapper that adds setup without removing a user step does not establish a delivery improvement. Read back the runner, results and bilingual demo before closing with a lesson. Preserve independent review for any public release.

description: The Treasury is unfunded and records no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The verified free catalogue workflow required seven downloads and two commands. Use that baseline to test whether one command reduces setup while still catching the duplicate-image defect. A successful offline trial would establish a delivery improvement. Buyer demand, order acceptance and settlement still require separate evidence. Public release remains subject to the host’s independent review gate.
